intent.subtype: input width chosen by a build define
intent.rationale: The sample width is 8 or 12 bits depending on the WIDE_SAMPLES define supplied by the flow; the register truncates only when the define is set, which the file cannot decide.

labels.note: din is truncated to 8 bits when WIDE_SAMPLES makes it 12 bits wide; widths match otherwise.
With WIDE_SAMPLES din is 12 bits and dout <= din drops its top 4 bits; default 8-bit build is fine. Depends on a build macro.

settlement.note: With no defines SAMPLE_W is 8, so dout <= din is 8 bits to 8 bits; truncation exists only under WIDE_SAMPLES, which is not this configuration.

rationale: With no defines SAMPLE_W is 8, so dout <= din is 8 bits to 8 bits; truncation exists only under WIDE_SAMPLES, which is not this configuration.
